$comment: Corrections and named exceptions under DR-0036. Each entry is one change that a minor or patch release of the major may make although the additive-minor rules forbid it. It names a schema location by document and JSON pointer; the change, which is a property the schema lets in (* opens the whole schema), a bound and its value, or a required name; the stable release it lands in; the published text it rests on, as a repository path and a quote from it; and the reason. The additive-minor check accepts exactly these changes. A PR that adds an entry is reviewed against DR-0036.
